notes: Crashes are counted per program. An incident filed by two programs (for example a Waymo and an other-AV collision) counts once under each, so per-program crash counts overlap and must not be summed across programs. The grand total of unique incidents is unique_incidents here and counts_total.unique_incidents in meta.json.
Reports are counted under each report's own program, month and file, so they do add up across programs.
A program's incident takes the highest severity among that program's own reports of it, and is placed in the month and file of that report.

row_notes.crashes: unique incident_key within the program (see notes: not additive across programs)
row_notes.fatal: crashes whose highest severity is fatal (SGO gives severity, not a death count)
row_notes.injury: crashes with any injury severity: minor, moderate, serious or fatal
row_notes.reports: current reports filed under this program, month and file
row_notes.serious_plus: crashes with serious or fatal severity
row_notes.vru: crashes where a report of the program carries the vru tag (structured field or narrative keyword)
row_notes.vru_field: as vru, structured field only (comparable across redaction levels)

unit: unique crashes per program (distinct incident_key within the program)
